_comment: County parcel adapters. There is no national parcel API, so each county is configured
individually against its public ArcGIS Feature/Map Service. Add a county by finding its
parcel layer (GET /api/parcel-sources?address=... suggests candidates via the ArcGIS
Online search API), then mapping its field names below. Every field is optional except
address; anything absent simply does not render.
value_basis: 'market' when the value field is the appraiser's market value, or a decimal
fraction (e.g. 0.35) when the county publishes an assessed value at that ratio, so the app
can convert back to market. Verify empirically against Zillow ZHVI for the same ZIP before

39035.attribution: Cuyahoga County Fiscal Office / CCGIS open data

non_disclosure_states._note: States where sale prices are not public record. Assessed values and property characteristics are still available, but sold comps are not.
